channels.spacesNote: fallback only -- live bootstrap ranks list_spaces (Surf Phase B, decision B5). shell.mjs's pickBootstrap() overwrites this array at first-signal acquisition with the top-3 'social'-classed spaces by last_activity, and persists the pick to localStorage['surf.feedSpaces'] so every later boot re-applies it before this file is even read again. This trio is used ONLY when list_spaces returns no 'social' space at all (a fresh/empty node) or on a first-ever run before any pick has landed.
